subdivision_of_building: Basement & Ground Floor & Part First Floor (To Rear of Site)
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-a3e308f4-7fff-cb89-7a72-9285799a9577"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">In the absence of sufficient information relating to the proposed use of the additional planning unit at first and second floors, the proposal will fail to make the best use of land as required by policies </span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">GG2 (Making the best use of land) and</span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"> D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach) of the London Plan (2021) and </span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Part I of policy LP27 (Protecting and Promoting Office Floorspace in the Borough) and </span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">policy LP12 (Meeting Housing Needs and Locations for New Homes) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020). </span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-2203ce45-7fff-1352-26e5-f99546f653cc"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposal, by introducing a late-night activity without a robust management plan, would lead to unacceptable levels of noise, disturbance, and potential anti-social behaviour, and harm the living conditions of nearby residents and other town centre users. This conflicts with policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design led approach) and D14 (Noise) of the London Plan (2021), as well as policies LP2 (Development and Amenity), LP9 (Health and Wellbeing), LP38 (Evening and Night-Time Economy), and LP58 (Improving the Environment - Pollution) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-a0413d3f-7fff-5b17-8fc6-eaa15e7a3f06"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed cycle store, due to its failure to provide sufficient space for adequate access and manoeuvrability, fails to provide accessible, safe and secure cycle storage for the operation of the bingo hall/adult gaming centre and thus fails to promote sustainable transport modes. The development would be contrary to&nbsp; policies T1 (Strategic approach to transport), T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impacts), and T5 (Cycling) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP41 (Liveable Neighbourhoods), LP42 (Walking and Cycling), and LP43 (Transport and Development) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020), and the London Cycling Design Standards (2016). </span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-e1247386-7fff-5122-d53e-5992e5a8dda2"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed change of use from Class E (office) to Sui Generis (bingo hall/adult gaming centre) would result in the unjustified loss of employment space, with no robust evidence that the office floorspace is no longer required or viable. The development would therefore conflict with Part I of policy LP27 (Protecting and Promoting Office Floorspace in the Borough) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020), policy GG2 (Making the best use of land), and E1 (Offices) of the London Plan (2021), and paragraphs 90-95 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-4da50318-7fff-7d9b-78c2-f68d36a8abac"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed change of use to a bingo hall/adult gaming centre (Sui Generis Use) would result in an over-concentration of gambling establishments within Hackney Town Centre, which already experiences a number of such uses in close proximity. This would negatively impact the vitality, viability, and character of this part of the town centre and the surrounding area, as well as the health and wellbeing of the local community. The absence of an adequate Health Impact Assessment or evidence addressing health inequalities, further exacerbates these concerns. As such, the proposal is contrary to policy SD6 (Town centres and high streets) of the London Plan (2021), and policies PP3 (Hackney Central and Surrounds), LP9 (Health and Wellbeing), LP38 (Evening and Night-Time Economy), and LP39 (Over-concentration of Uses) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020), and paragraphs 96-102 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).</span></span></p>
description: Change of use of basement & ground floor & part first floor (to rear of site) from a vacant bank (Use Class E) to a bingo hall (Use Class Sui Generis) and associated alterations to front elevation.  Proposed hours of opening 08:00 – 00:30 (the following day) Monday to Friday, 08:00 – 01:00 (the following day) on Saturday, and 09:00 - 01:00 (the following day) on Sunday.
